parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: A list of topics or regex patterns the consumer should subscribe to.

parameters.name: kafka_config_id
parameters.description: The connection object to use, defaults to "kafka_default"

parameters.name: apply_function
parameters.description: The function that should be applied to fetched one at a time. name of dag file executing the function and the function name delimited by a `.`

parameters.name: apply_function_batch
parameters.description: The function that should be applied to a batch of messages fetched. Can not be used with `apply_function`. Intended for transactional workloads where an expensive task might be called before or after operations on the messages are taken.

parameters.name: apply_function_args
parameters.description: Additional arguments that should be applied to the callable, defaults to None

parameters.name: apply_function_kwargs
parameters.description: Additional key word arguments that should be applied to the callable defaults to None

parameters.name: commit_cadence
parameters.description: When consumers should commit offsets ("never", "end_of_batch","end_of_operator"), defaults to "end_of_operator"; if end_of_operator, the commit() is called based on the max_messages arg. Commits are made after the operator has processed the apply_function method for the maximum messages in the operator. if end_of_batch, the commit() is called based on the max_batch_size arg. Commits are made after each batch has processed by the apply_function method for all messages in the batch. if never, close() is called without calling the commit() method.

parameters.name: max_messages
parameters.description: The maximum total number of messages an operator should read from Kafka, defaults to None implying read to the end of the topic.

parameters.name: max_batch_size
parameters.description: The maximum number of messages a consumer should read when polling, defaults to 1000

parameters.name: poll_timeout
parameters.description: How long the Kafka consumer should wait before determining no more messages are available, defaults to 60

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The topic the producer should produce to, defaults to None

parameters.name: producer_function
parameters.description: The function that generates key/value pairs as messages for production, defaults to None

parameters.name: kafka_config_id
parameters.description: The connection object to use, defaults to "kafka_default"

parameters.name: producer_function_args
parameters.description: Additional arguments to be applied to the producer callable, defaults to None

parameters.name: producer_function_kwargs
parameters.description: Additional keyword arguments to be applied to the producer callable, defaults to None

parameters.name: delivery_callback
parameters.description: The callback to apply after delivery(or failure) of a message, defaults to None

parameters.name: synchronous
parameters.description: If writes to kafka should be fully synchronous, defaults to True

parameters.name: poll_timeout
parameters.description: How long of a delay should be applied when calling poll after production to kafka, defaults to 0

parameters.description: The connection object to use, defaults to "kafka_default"
